method: Exact SymPy identities and a rational unit-quaternion example; no empirical data.
quaternion_convention: Scalar-first Hamilton q; body-to-space action; qdot=1/2 q tensor (0,omega_body).
checks: q^T N=0; N^T N=(q^T q) I_3/4; N N^T=((q^T q) I_4-q q^T)/4.
Point derivative D_q[R(q) a] N omega_body equals R(q)(omega_body cross a).
At q=(1,1,1,1)/2, omega_body=(2,-1,3), tau_q=(1,3,-2,4), both power pairings equal 9/2.
For J=diag(2,3,4), M_q=16 N J N^T has rank3; M_q+q q^T is SPD and gives the same kinetic energy on qdot=N v. Redundant coordinates do not force every ambient extension to be singular.
Integrator exact held-input update F=x+h u has A=1,B=h; continuous input derivative is1, zero-drift input derivative is0.
For full continuous field x^2+x u, A=2x+u and B=x at the declared pair. Differentiating x^2 alone misses nominal-input dependence.
scope: Supports notation distinctions and conservative regularity language; does not modify chapter equations or validate a golfer model.
